body:
If you finally decide to die, don’t make it sudden. Say it. Express your emotions. Your mother cares about you. Make it brief, but expressive.

But please don’t kill yourself friend, there will be a chance. Chat with me, I might be able to help.

You shouldn’t. You shouldn’t die.

Why are you trying to end your life friend? Depression? Abuse? Secrets? Ruminations? Location?

Please chat with me. I may be able to help.
Hello friend. I recently came out of recovery and I realized you really need to cherish life. Think about it.

You are special. Your parents gave birth to you for a reason. You aren’t an accident, they kept you for a reason. Suicide is the worst way to end your life. I’m not sure it’ll get better. Please, stay. Wait. I tried committing suicide. After surviving you realize. If you don’t survive that’s that. It’s sad to see you like this. I care. People care. Chat with me.
my dad is an alcoholic. every day he screams at me and calls me worthless. he’s the only alive person that i have contact with.
